### 2026-10-24 – # Planning and Schematic!

**6h**

# Planning and Schematic!

## tl;dr
I planned out my design, finished the schematic and footprint assignments!
## Planning
My basic idea is using [esp32 S3](https://www.berrybase.de/en/waveshare-esp32-s3-wroom-1-n8r8-microcontroller-aiot-wi-fi-bt-ble-240mhz-dual-core-without-header) and [PCM5102](https://www.adafruit.com/product/6250) with [TPA6132A2](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpa6132a2.pdf?ts=1792813412028) and some power management with [boost converter](https://kuriosity.sg/products/dc-dc-step-up-boost-converter-2-5-vout-to-5-12v-1a-5w) and TP4056.
